Fin du Game est un podcast francophone c: Fin du Game is a French-language podcast about the world of video games. It mixes gaming news, cultural analysis and passionate discussion of the games that defined their era.
Un podcast sur les jeux vidéo qui dépass: A video game podcast that goes beyond simple reviews to dig into the meaning, history and cultural impact of games. Long format, deep analysis, infectious passion — the kind of content that makes you want to switch a console back on. Our verdict: "It's the podcast that made me love podcasts." — Alex. It isn't only for hardcore gamers: anyone who wants to think about what they play, without snobbery, will find what they're looking for. A gateway to another way of experiencing video games.
